comments.body:
🚨 severity: BLOCKING —
🚨 **BLOCKING: S0 is never invalidated on projection-replacing host transitions — the merged hand-over runs over the wrong context**

The ticket (AC2, `input/gh-2394/ticket.md`: "инвалидация по списку: switch сессии / checkout ветки; checkpoint rewind/restore; …") and this PR's own doc (`lib/src/agent/agent.dart:345-347`: "Hosts invalidate it on branch switch / checkpoint restore") require the request snapshot to be dropped whenever the projection it describes is replaced. Only **two** host invalidation sites exist in the whole diff (engine switch `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart:535`, post-run `:1131` / `flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service_compaction.dart:343`); `RequestSnapshotStore.validFor` checks **only the model**, and `Agent.reset()` (`lib/src/agent/agent.dart:631`) clears messages but not the snapshot store. So every projection-replacing flow below leaves a **stale S0 that still counts as valid**:

- **Session switch / in-process resume** — this line sets the new session's tag epoch but never drops the old session's S0 (`_switchSession` → `_agent.reset()` keeps the store; `flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service_sessions.dart:324` is the same gap on the app host);
- **Checkpoint rewind / restore** — `_applyRewind` prunes `state.messages` (`lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart:461-466`), the CLI's `onRewindApplied` only sets `_persistedCount` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart:1019, :1087`); `/checkpoint restore` likewise swaps the projection with **no send in between**, so the stale pre-restore S0 survives until the restore budget guard (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart:885`) or the next prompt's pre-flight (`:291-296`) resolves `validFor(model)` → true and feeds the rewound-away prefix into the merged hand-over (hide aliases then resolve through the stale frozen seqMap, `lib/src/compaction/request_snapshot.dart:68-72`);
- **`/handoff`** — replaces the transcript with the digest (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_handoff.dart:238`);
- **CLI partial appends** — S0 is invalidated only `if (hooks.reportedPass)` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart:1129-1131`), but `_appendHandOverRecords` can append the hidden range and *then* hit a ladder kill (`lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart:196-220`) — records landed, `reportedPass` is false, S0 stays.
- **Over-window emergency relief** — `relief.run()` re-anchors the transcript (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart:1209`) but the relief path only keeps `_persistedCount` in step (`:1210-1213`), never invalidates; the app mirror is `_relieveOverWindow` (`flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart:280, :900`, sole invalidation still the after-run hook). The post-run soft trigger then reads the stale **pre-relief** S0 as valid and builds the merged hand-over over the over-window prefix — a cache-cold, likely-overflowing call whose disposal picks mostly drop against the fresh projection.

Concrete failure: `/session switch` (or `/resume`) onto a session whose transcript is at/over the hard line → the **first prompt's pre-flight compaction** selects `merged` (snapshot "valid": same model) and sends the **previous session's transcript** as the hand-over prefix while naming the new session's fold range. The ask-verification gate usually fails (a compaction outage loop on exactly the sessions that need it most), but two sessions in the same repo routinely share user-request lines — then the check passes and a **wrong-session transfer text is appended into the new session's file** as a `compact_checkpoint` covering the new range.

The store-level test (`test/compaction/request_snapshot_test.dart`, "E20") calls `store.invalidate(...)` **by hand** — it proves the mechanism but no host ever invokes it on these paths, so the gap is invisible to the suite.

Fix: invalidate the store (or key it by session) on the session-load/switch paths, the rewind `_applyRewind`, `/checkpoint restore`, `/handoff`, the over-window relief paths on **both** hosts, and drop the `reportedPass` condition in favor of "any run that may have appended" (the Flutter host already does the unconditional variant).

comments.body:
🚨 severity: BLOCKING —
🚨 **BLOCKING: `##Open User Requests` (no space) passes the mandatory-section gate but blinds the provenance belt — laundering path reopens**

The gate and the belt it exists to arm use **divergent heading regexes**:

- gate (`lib/src/compaction/structured/hand_over.dart:291-293`): `^(?:#{1,6}\s*)?(?:open user requests\b|open asks\b\s*:)` — `\s*`, **zero** whitespace accepted;
- belt (`lib/src/compaction/summary_sanitizer.dart:208-211`): `^(?:#{1,6}\s+)?…` — `\s+`, **one-or-more** required, with an early return when no heading matches (`:276`: `if (!_userIntentHeading.hasMatch(text)) return text;`).

Order of operations in `_handOverTransfer` (`lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart:160-170`): `sanitizeSummary` runs **first**, then `verifyOpenUserRequests`. A reply that writes the heading as `##Open User Requests` or `#open asks:` (no space — trivially steerable by payload-injected tool text, the PR's own threat model input 1/3) therefore:

1. gets **no belt grading** — machine-origin synthetic asks and unevidenced tool quotes inside the section ride into the durable `compact_checkpoint` unstripped, unmarked — the exact laundering class gh-2103 and ticket D2/#81 close ("belt не работает без заголовка", N1);
2. still **passes** `verifyOpenUserRequests` (heading `true`, asks verbatim) — so the run persists and reports success.

The gate's own doc says the opposite contract: "without it the sanitizer belt cannot run, so the run FAILS" (`hand_over.dart:299-302`). Fix: share one heading pattern (gate adopts `\s+`, or both reuse a single exported regex), and add the `##Open…` variant as a payload fixture (ticket UT-12/IT-09 list).

comments.body:
⚠️ severity: IMPORTANT —
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: `CompactingGate.run` joins a second caller unregistered — the joined body escapes the D9 queue**

`CompactingGate.run` (`lib/src/compaction/hand_over_trigger.dart:153-165`) joins a caller while a run is in flight by awaiting the active completer and then executing `body()` **without re-registering it** (`:156-157`). During that joined body `isCompacting` is `false` and `wait()` (`:170-176`) returns immediately.

Concrete interleaving on both hosts: run A settles → post-run compaction #1 holds the gate; a run that does not pass `_beginUserPrompt` (a reaction/scheduled/background-job run) settles while #1 is still in flight → `_afterRun`'s `gate.run` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_run.dart:367`) joins → body #2 executes unregistered after #1 completes; a user prompt arriving during body #2 now skips the queue (`agent_service.dart:2021` checks `isCompacting`; `_beginUserPrompt`'s `gate.wait()`, `agent_cli_run.dart:138`, returns immediately) and its pre-flight measures/compacts while #2's appends and `_refreshState` are mid-flight — the exact double-`_refreshState`/lost-persist hazard D9/AC12 (E33, IT-19) introduces the gate to prevent. `wait()`'s while-loop only re-checks registered runs, so it cannot catch this either.

Fix: in the join branch, register the joined body as the active compaction (set `_active` before `body()`, complete in `finally`), so `isCompacting`/`wait()` see it; a unit test with two overlapping `run` calls + a concurrent `wait()` would pin it (none exists today).

comments.body:
⚠️ severity: IMPORTANT —
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: the verbatim-asks check normalizes one side only — a session whose asks carry wire-tag/zero-width text can never fold (permanent fail-closed loop)**

`verifyOpenUserRequests` (`lib/src/compaction/structured/hand_over.dart:314-328`) compares the **normalized** reply against the **raw** mechanical block:

- reply side: `sanitizeSummary(stripRecordTags(stripThinkBlocks(raw)), …)` (`engine_hand_over.dart:163`) — `stripRecordTags` drops a leading `m<digits> ` from **every** line (`record_tag.dart:63-65`) and the belt may append ` [from toolResult]` annotations;
- mechanical side: `userRequestCandidateLines` output — raw record text, only `\s+`-flattened at `hand_over.dart:323`; U+200B/U+200C/U+200D/U+2060 are not `\s` and survive there.

So a user turn that starts with `m<digits> ` (quoting an alias) or contains a zero-width char (pasted text) can **never** be contained in the normalized transfer → the run fails (E36) and nothing is appended. With no fallback (AC4 by design), every subsequent post-run soft trigger re-runs the 2–3 round-trip hand-over and fails again: a **permanent compaction stall** for that session, loud but unfixable without editing history. A sanitizer `[from toolResult]` mark inside an echoed ask breaks verbatim the same way (ticket AC6 wants asks verbatim; `protectedLines` covers only pinned lines).

Fix: normalize both sides identically — run the mechanical ask lines through the same zero-width/tag stripping before the containment check (and/or pass the ask lines as `protectedLines` so the belt keeps them byte-stable).

comments.body:
⚠️ severity: IMPORTANT —
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: the merged persist site's provenance gate has no hostile-text test — a regression re-opens laundering with the suite green**

The merged persist site runs the gh-2103 laundering gate (`lib/src/compaction/structured/engine_hand_over.dart:162-165`: `sanitizeSummary(stripRecordTags(stripThinkBlocks(raw)), protectedLines: c.pinnedLines, origins: SummaryOriginEvidence(snapshot.messages))`), but **no test in this PR ever feeds a hostile transfer**:

- every `hand_over_pass_test.dart` fixture is clean text; the only negative content asserted is `<think>` absence (`:236-238`);
- `test/compaction/provenance_laundering_test.dart:14-16` scopes its layer-3 persist-path coverage to "classic compaction, structured checkpoints, branch digests" — the new merged site is not in the list;
- the ticket's payload-fixture list (Security section / IT-09) explicitly demands the "quoted fake user turn" fixture and REG-11 demands the persist-site gate with `protectedLines`.

If a later refactor drops `origins:` or `protectedLines:` from this call, tool-controlled text is laundered into trusted memory again and **no test fails** — precisely the "gate фактически выключен" class the ticket's review round 2 called out (N1). Add a pass-level test: a transfer quoting a forged ask planted in a tool result must come out origin-marked/`[from toolResult]`, and a pinned-operative line must survive verbatim.

⚠️ **IMPORTANT: the host wirings that carry D9/AC12/E21 have no test — two-line regressions ship green**

The gate and store primitives are unit-tested, but the shipped seams are not exercised anywhere in the diff:

- **No host-level test sends a prompt while the post-run call is in flight** (E2E-04/IT-19's host leg): neither the CLI's `gate.run(() => _maybeAutoCompact(postRun: true))` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_run.dart:367`) nor the Flutter pair (`agent_service_events.dart:241-243`, `agent_service.dart:2021`) is covered — the #2258 double-refresh/incident class this wiring exists for can regress silently;
- **Success-only S0 invalidation**: the CLI drops the snapshot only `if (hooks.reportedPass)` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart:1129-1131`); no test pins that after a successful merged run the next pre-flight goes **standalone** because S0 was invalidated (E21: "S0 после рана невалиден"; `request_snapshot_test.dart:124-131` only calls `store.invalidate('compaction ran')` by hand);
- the Flutter equivalents (`agent_service_compaction.dart:331-343`) are likewise unexercised for these transitions (the existing `compaction_host_wiring_test.dart` additions do not cover them).

A regression deleting either two-line wiring flips mode selection or reintroduces the double-writer race with all tests green. Add: a CLI-scoped test that runs a merged pass and asserts the next pre-flight selects standalone (store empty/invalid), and a prompt-during-post-run interleaving test on one host.

comments.body:
⚠️ severity: IMPORTANT —
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: new `compaction` tuning knobs are honored only on the CLI — host-parity contract broken**

The PR adds three shared-looking knobs — `compaction.softRatio`, `compaction.handOver.maxTokens`, `compaction.handOver.hysteresisTurns` (`lib/src/compaction/tuning.dart:79-85, :106-117`) — but only `resolveCliCompactionWiring` parses them (`lib/src/compaction/host_wiring.dart:196-210`). The app's `_compactionWiring` getter calls `resolveCompactionHostWiring` **without** the `tuning:` argument (`flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service_compaction.dart:232-236`), and the app config loader never parses the section's tuning keys at all — so `wiring.handOverHysteresisTurns` (read at `:268`) and `wiring.softRatio` (read at `:294`) are structurally always `null` on the app: it runs the defaults forever while the CLI applies user config.

`docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md:7-12` requires a shared setting to work on BOTH hosts or an explicit `cliOnlySettings` entry with a WHY; `compaction` is owned by the **shared** `compactionEngine` setting (`lib/src/parity/settings_registry.dart:856-865`) and is absent from `cliOnlySettings` (`:165-222`). The AC5 parity test cannot catch the drift because `CompactionHostWiring.sameResolutionAs` omits the three new fields (`lib/src/compaction/host_wiring.dart:117-134` compares window/conversationWindow/settings scalars/enabled/maxAttempts/baseBackoff/smol only).

Fix: parse the tuning keys in `loadAppFahConfig` and pass them into `_compactionWiring` (plus add the three fields to `sameResolutionAs` so the parity test actually compares them) — or declare the exemption in the registry with a reason.

comments.body:
💡 severity: SUGGESTION —
💡 **SUGGESTION: the new `[expand …]` branch of `isCompactionMarkerText` is end-anchored only — ordinary content ending in a quoted pointer flips real boundaries**

`_expandPointerPattern = RegExp(r'\[expand \d+(?:-\d+)?\]\s*$')` (`lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart:164`, consumed at `:177-181`) classifies **any** message text that merely *ends* with a bracketed `[expand N]`/`[expand N-M]` as a compaction marker. The legacy branch is start-anchored (`^\[\d+…:(hidden|ckpt)·`, `:155`) and essentially never occurs naturally; the new form does — this repo's own docs and skill texts quote `[expand 3-140]` routinely, and a tool result whose last line is such a quote now matches.

Three boundary detectors key off the predicate, where the false positive has real cost:

- `isPinRenumberingBoundary` (`lib/src/skills/operative_pins.dart:396-412`): after a false boundary the pinned-operative carrier block is **suppressed** for the rest of the window — a "pinned verbatim" directive silently stops rendering although the skill body is not in context;
- `_nearestCutBoundary` (`lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart:702`): pairing diagnostics mislabeled "context marker";
- the image registry's citation-trust boundary (issue #195 F2).

The ticket's D12/security blessing covers **forged** markers in tool text as safe degradation — not this accidental-match class on genuine content. Suggest anchoring to the engine-rendered whole-line form: optional `m<N> ` tag, then at most a ≤6-word bracket-free label, then the pointer at end-of-text — coincidental quotes then resolve like the old start-anchored form.

comments.body:
💡 severity: SUGGESTION —
💡 **SUGGESTION: the classic parity suite strips `m<N> ` before shape checks — a classic-engine tag leak would ship green (E37/AC15 unasserted)**

`contentSignatures` (`test/cli/agent_cli_resume_parity_test.dart:175-180`) strips `^(user|assistant|tool):m\d+ ` before the `user:old`-style shape comparisons, and the suite pins `compactionEngine.classic` (`:116`, `:138`) — but **no assertion anywhere checks that classic wires carry no tags** (E37: "classic: тегов и merged нет"). `verifyOpenUserRequests` (`lib/src/compaction/structured/hand_over.dart:314-328`) compares the **normalized** reply against the **raw** mechanical block:

- reply side: `sanitizeSummary(stripRecordTags(stripThinkBlocks(raw)), …)` (`engine_hand_over.dart:163`) — `stripRecordTags` drops a leading `m<digits> ` from **every** line (`record_tag.dart:63-65`) and the belt may append ` [from toolResult]` annotations;
- mechanical side: `userRequestCandidateLines` output — raw record text, only `\s+`-flattened at `hand_over.dart:323`; U+200B/U+200C/U+200D/U+2060 are not `\s` and survive there.

So a user turn that starts with `m<digits> ` (quoting an alias) or contains a zero-width char (pasted text) can **never** be contained in the normalized transfer → the run fails (E36) and nothing is appended. With no fallback (AC4 by design), every subsequent post-run soft trigger re-runs the 2–3 round-trip hand-over and fails again: a **permanent compaction stall** for that session, loud but unfixable without editing history. A sanitizer `[from toolResult]` mark inside an echoed ask breaks verbatim the same way (ticket AC6 wants asks verbatim; `protectedLines` covers only pinned lines).

Fix: normalize both sides identically — run the mechanical ask lines through the same zero-width/tag stripping before the containment check (and/or pass the ask lines as `protectedLines` so the belt keeps them byte-stable).

⚠️ severity: IMPORTANT —

The PR adds three shared-looking knobs — `compaction.softRatio`, `compaction.handOver.maxTokens`, `compaction.handOver.hysteresisTurns` (`lib/src/compaction/tuning.dart:79-85, :106-117`) — but only `resolveCliCompactionWiring` parses them (`lib/src/compaction/host_wiring.dart:196-210`). `docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md:7-12` requires a shared setting to work on BOTH hosts or an explicit `cliOnlySettings` entry with a WHY; `compaction` is owned by the **shared** `compactionEngine` setting (`lib/src/parity/settings_registry.dart:856-865`) and is absent from `cliOnlySettings` (`:165-222`). Fix: parse the tuning keys in `loadAppFahConfig` and pass them into `_compactionWiring` (plus add the three fields to `sameResolutionAs` so the parity test actually compares them) — or declare the exemption in the registry with a reason.

💡 severity: SUGGESTION —
💡 **SUGGESTION: the new `[expand …]` branch of `isCompactionMarkerText` is end-anchored only — ordinary content ending in a quoted pointer flips real boundaries**

`_expandPointerPattern = RegExp(r'\[expand \d+(?:-\d+)?\]\s*$')` (`lib/src/compaction/structured/markers.dart:164`, consumed at `:177-181`) classifies **any** message text that merely *ends* with a bracketed `[expand N]`/`[expand N-M]` as a compaction marker. The legacy branch is start-anchored (`^\[\d+…:(hidden|ckpt)·`, `:155`) and essentially never occurs naturally; the new form does — this repo's own docs and skill texts quote `[expand 3-140]` routinely, and a tool result whose last line is such a quote now matches.

Three boundary detectors key off the predicate, where the false positive has real cost:

- `isPinRenumberingBoundary` (`lib/src/skills/operative_pins.dart:396-412`): after a false boundary the pinned-operative carrier block is **suppressed** for the rest of the window — a "pinned verbatim" directive silently stops rendering although the skill body is not in context;
- `_nearestCutBoundary` (`lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart:702`): pairing diagnostics mislabeled "context marker";
- the image registry's citation-trust boundary (issue #195 F2).

The ticket's D12/security blessing covers **forged** markers in tool text as safe degradation — not this accidental-match class on genuine content. Suggest anchoring to the engine-rendered whole-line form: optional `m<N> ` tag, then at most a ≤6-word bracket-free label, then the pointer at end-of-text — coincidental quotes then resolve like the old start-anchored form.

comments.body:
## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: The merged hand-over core (parser, dispose buckets, no-fallback ladder, marker forms, session-record backward compat) is solid and well-tested, but two blocking defects and one contract gap must be fixed first: the request snapshot (S0) is never invalidated on session switch / rewind / `/handoff` / partial appends, so the merged call can run over the *wrong session's* transcript; and a heading-variant (`##Open User Requests`, no space) passes the mandatory-section gate while blinding the provenance belt, reopening the gh-2103 laundering path.

**Key Issues** (2 🚨 · 6 ⚠️ · 6 💡 · 4 🪶):
- 🚨 Stale S0 across projection-replacing host transitions (session switch/resume, checkpoint rewind **and restore**, `/handoff`, partial appends, over-window relief) → merged hand-over over the wrong context / compaction outage loop (`session_commands.dart:985`, thread 1).
- 🚨 Gate/belt heading regex divergence (`\s*` vs `\s+`) → ungraded user-intent section persisted (`hand_over.dart:292`, thread 2).
- ⚠️ `CompactingGate.run` joins bodies unregistered → D9 queue bypassed (`hand_over_trigger.dart:157`); ⚠️ verbatim-asks normalization is one-sided → permanent fail-closed fold stall (`hand_over.dart:323`); ⚠️ AC19/D1 gap: the judge ladder is kept (PR self-declares; ticket D1 says judge removed and hide-only mode abolished — needs an explicit owner call or the follow-up card); ⚠️ merged persist-site laundering gate has no hostile-text test; ⚠️ host D9/E21 wiring (gate seam, success-only S0 invalidation) untested; ⚠️ new `compaction` tuning knobs parsed by the CLI only — the app structurally ignores them and `sameResolutionAs` omits the fields, so the AC5 parity test can't catch the drift (`agent_service_compaction.dart:268`, thread 13).
- 🪶 digest: `legacy_session_resume_test.dart:350` duplicate assertion · `prompts/compaction/hand_over.md:3` unquoted YAML `#` truncates the generated doc · `engine_hand_over.dart:275` `judgeCalls` reused for hand-over call count · `record_tag.dart:187` a genuine record opening with `m<N> ` is treated as already tagged (alias confusion).

**Next Steps**:
1. Invalidate/key S0 on session load-switch, rewind, `/checkpoint restore`, `/handoff`, the relief paths on both hosts, and any run that appended (drop the `reportedPass` condition) + host-level lifecycle test.
2. Share one user-intent heading regex between gate and belt + add the `##Open…` payload fixture.
3. Register joined gate bodies; normalize both sides of the verbatim-asks check.
4. Owner decision on AC19 (judge removal) — land it here or split a dedicated card.
5. Parse `compaction.*` tuning in the app loader and pass it into `_compactionWiring`; add the three fields to `sameResolutionAs` (or declare the `cliOnlySettings` exemption with a WHY).
6. Add the hostile-transfer and host-wiring tests; then the 💡 threads (marker end-anchor, parity tag-strip, Copilot header, IT-10/IT-17 tails).
